book_vs_repo_gap: This chapter is adapted and only faithful in miniature: it demonstrates alignment mechanics but omits decoder rollout, beam search, and corpus-level MT evaluation.

chapter_notes.counterintuitive_insight: The pedagogical heart of neural MT is not BLEU-scale evaluation but making alignment pressure visible as a distinct object from token prediction.
covered_claims: A context vector and decoder state are combined for target prediction.
Alignment normalization can be checked independently of translation accuracy.

failure_modes.note: Machine translation quality depends on decoding policy; this toy chapter scores only a single decoder step.

lesson_objectives: Make encoder-decoder attention visible as an alignment object.
Separate alignment normalization from target-token prediction quality.
Show what is gained and lost when translation is reduced to a single-step toy decoder.

reference_experiments.expected_signal: toy seq2seq setup separates simple target classes
reference_experiments.name: single_step_translation_accuracy

title: Machine Translation
